titleEn: Count Unguarded Cells in the Grid
title: 统计网格图中没有被保卫的格子数
summary: 警卫沿四个直线方向看守直到被墙或其他警卫阻挡，统计既非墙警卫又未被看守的格子。
insight: 状态矩阵区分空、墙、警卫、被看守。对每个警卫沿四方向走到阻挡物，空格标成被看守；最后统计仍为空的格。
pitfalls: 被看守格不会阻挡视线
警卫与墙本身不计未守格

solutions.title: 警卫四向射线标记
solutions.idea: 从每个警卫传播视线直到实体阻挡。
steps: 对 guard 的四方向逐格前进；遇 state 二或三停止，否则 state=1

code.java: class Solution { public int countUnguarded(int m,int n,int[][] guards,int[][] walls){int[][] state=new int[m][n];for(int[] wall:walls)state[wall[0]][wall[1]]=2;for(int[] guard:guards)state[guard[0]][guard[1]]=3;int[][] directions={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}};for(int[] guard:guards)for(int[] direction:directions){int row=guard[0]+direction[0],column=guard[1]+direction[1];while(row>=0&&row<m&&column>=0&&column<n&&state[row][column]!=2&&state[row][column]!=3){state[row][column]=1;row+=direction[0];column+=direction[1];}}int answer=0;for(int[] row:state)for(int value:row)if(value==0)answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countUnguarded(m:Int,n:Int,guards:Array<IntArray>,walls:Array<IntArray>):Int{val state=Array(m){IntArray(n)};for(wall in walls)state[wall[0]][wall[1]]=2;for(guard in guards)state[guard[0]][guard[1]]=3;val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(-1,0),intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(0,-1));for(guard in guards)for(direction in directions){var row=guard[0]+direction[0];var column=guard[1]+direction[1];while(row in 0 until m&&column in 0 until n&&state[row][column]!=2&&state[row][column]!=3){state[row][column]=1;row+=direction[0];column+=direction[1]}};return state.sumOf{row->row.count{it==0}}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countUnguarded(int m,int n,vector<vector<int>>& guards,vector<vector<int>>& walls){vector<vector<int>> state(m,vector<int>(n));for(auto& wall:walls)state[wall[0]][wall[1]]=2;for(auto& guard:guards)state[guard[0]][guard[1]]=3;int directions[5]={1,0,-1,0,1};for(auto& guard:guards)for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int row=guard[0]+directions[d],column=guard[1]+directions[d+1];while(row>=0&&row<m&&column>=0&&column<n&&state[row][column]!=2&&state[row][column]!=3){state[row][column]=1;row+=directions[d];column+=directions[d+1];}}int answer=0;for(auto& row:state)answer+=count(row.begin(),row.end(),0);return answer;} };
